title: Get Shop SKU Performance List
content:
# Path: /analytics/202509/shop_skus/performance
# Method: [GET]
# Function Description
Returns a paginated list of performance metrics for the shop's SKUs over the requested date range.

---


# Common Parameters
For common parameters, refer to [How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f199679495ef0281851ee5#Back%20To%20Top)
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Location <!-- width:75px --> | Type <!-- width:75px --> | Require <!-- width:60px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shop_cipher | query | string | Y | GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 | Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. |
| Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9) |  |  |  |  |  |
| content-type | header | string | Y | application/json | Allowed type: application/json |
# Request Query Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| app_key | string | Y | 38abcd | Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app. |
| sign | string | Y | 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c | Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders. |
| timestamp | int | Y | 1623812664 | Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time. |
| start_date_ge | string | Y | 2026-10-01 | Start time (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, inclusive. |
| end_date_lt | string | Y | 2026-10-08 | End date of the performance period, exclusive, in the shop's registered time zone. Use YYYY-MM-DD format. It must be later than start_date_ge. |
| page_size | int | N | 10 | Number of records per page. If omitted, defaults to 10. Maximum: 100. |
| page_token | string | N | cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ== | Token that identifies the page to retrieve. Omit it for the first page. For later pages, pass the `next_page_token` returned by the previous response and reuse the same `start_date_ge`, `end_date_lt`, `sort_field`, `sort_order`, `category_filter`, `product_status_filter`, `product_ids`, `currency`, and `page_size` values. |
| sort_field | string | N | gmv | Sort field, possible values: |

* gmv (default)
* sku_orders
* units_sold |
   sort_order |string |N |DESC |Sort direction, possible values:
* DESC (default)
* ASC |
   category_filter |[]string |N |123123,321412 |List of category IDs used to filter returned SKU performance records. |
   product_status_filter |string |N |LIVE |Filter SKUs by product status. Possible values:
* LIVE
* INACTIVE
* ALL (default) |
   product_ids |[]string |N |123456789,34909989 |Filter SKUs by product IDs. If product_ids are provided, the API will only return SKUs for the given product IDs, otherwise it will return all SKUs for the shop |
   currency |string |N |USD |Currency used to report GMV:
* USD: U.S. dollars
* LOCAL (default): Local currency where the shop is located |

# Request Sample
**Query**
```Plain Text
https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202509/shop_skus/performance?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&start_date_ge=2026-10-01&end_date_lt=2026-10-08&page_size=10&page_token=cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ==&sort_field=gmv&sort_order=DESC&category_filter=123123,321412&product_status_filter=LIVE&product_ids=123456789,34909989&currency=USD
```

# Response Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:289px --> | Properties description <!-- width:289px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | int | 0 | The success or failure status code returned in API response. |
| message | string | Success | The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message. |
| request_id | string | 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 | Request log |
| data | object |  | Specific return information |
| ^skus | []object |  | List of SKU performance metrics. |
| ^^id | int | 18354627263453 | The ID of the SKU in the returned SKU performance record. |
| ^^product_id | int | 123456789 | The ID of the product that the returned SKU belongs to. |
| ^^gmv | object |  | Overall Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) for the SKU. |
| ^^^amount | string | 135.42 | GMV amount in the corresponding currency. |
| ^^^currency | string | USD | GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP). |
| ^^sku_orders | int | 10 | Total (sum of all) orders for a SKU |
| ^^units_sold | int | 10 | Number of units sold for a SKU |
| ^next_page_token | string | cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ== | If nonempty, pass this token unchanged as `page_token` in the next request and reuse the same `start_date_ge`, `end_date_lt`, `page_size`, `sort_field`, `sort_order`, `currency`, `category_filter`, `product_status_filter`, and `product_ids` values. For optional parameters, preserve whether each parameter was omitted or present. An empty string means there are no more pages. |
| ^total_count | int | 20 | Total number of SKUs matching the request filters across all pages. |
| ^latest_available_date | string | 2024-04-07 | Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format). |
# Response Sample
```json
{"code":0,"data":{"skus":[{"id":18354627263453,"product_id":123456789,"gmv":{"amount":"135.42","currency":"USD"},"sku_orders":10,"units_sold":10}],"next_page_token":"cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ==","total_count":20,"latest_available_date":"2024-04-07"},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
```
